newsitem.title: UK: Liverpool cotton finds spinners shy of firmer offers.
newsitem.headline: Liverpool cotton finds spinners shy of firmer offers.

text.p: Spinners continued to inquire for cotton to cover spring and early summer needs, but genuine buying interest was somewhat lessened after trade offers seemed firmer.
These were influenced by a partial recovery on Thursday on New York futures.

Attention in European textile circles was diverted by Thursday's EU meeting in Brusseels which was to have decided whether to confirm anti-dumping duties on unbleached grey cloth from six external countries but which ended with no firm conclusion.
Provisional duties in force since November have assisted the recent recovery of primary textiles in Europe but adversely affected the finishing and downstream industries.
